items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: And they had a band called the Armourish Band too, a long time ago.

ctx.x: Vic and Sonny were the two best we had you. Teachers and blowing, playing too, you know. Two best we had you for teaching, you know. And playing, but Vic was better than Sonny in the orchestra, you know. Playing in the orchestra. But him and Sonny were tough out there on the screen there. Them two used to play together. Which bands did they play in? They played the Excelsior. They played with the Tuxedo. And they had a band called the Armourish Band too, a long time ago. What's the name of that band? Armourish…
Oh, I never knew that. Oh, Armourish. Oh, Armourish. Oh, Armourish. Oh. Oh. I was going to ask, what dance orchestras they played in? Well, dance orchestras. I don't remember.

Well, Vic, I believe he only played with Robichaud, John Robichaud. Oh, that's the Delaric Theatre. That's the Delaric Theatre. And sometimes when they leave the Delaric Theatre, they go play a dance job. Son Henry used to play at Pajoa and there was this what's called his dance I think it was Son Henry used to play a tuxedo it's play Celestine one time you know yeah Son Henry did a tuxedo did Vic Gasper ever
